summary: AuraFit backend regression suite created and executed against the public preview URL. 25/25 pytest cases passed (100%). Covered: auth (register both roles, login, /me, JWT enforcement, duplicate-email, invalid-token), profile (get empty/create-with-photos/persist, AI measurement estimate), items (CRUD + filters: category/size/color, ownership/role enforcement), Gemini Nano Banana try-on (returned 200 with image + fit_summary using small synthetic PNG; ~30s), tryon history, Stripe checkout (cs_test_... session), payment status (live Stripe fetch ok), orders list, and role enforcement (buyer cannot POST /items: 403; seller cannot checkout: 403). Note: not in scope but observed expo frontend build failing with duplicate 'Profile' default export in app/(tabs)/profile.tsx — flagged for main agent.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro/Babel build error: 'Duplicate declaration "Profile"'. The file exports `default function Profile()` while also using a same-named local/type identifier. Frontend bundling currently fails — out of scope for backend-only testing but breaks UI.

action_items: Frontend: rename either the default function or the conflicting `Profile` identifier in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx to resolve the duplicate declaration that breaks Metro bundling.
(Optional) Consider relaxing/normalising EmailStr deliverability for test/staging traffic — pydantic rejects reserved TLDs like .test (422). Currently tests use @aurafit.demo to work around this.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 830 lines — borderline of the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, profile, items, tryon, payments) for maintainability.
POST /api/payments/webhook does not enforce signature failure → returns 400 only on exception (acceptable, but emergentintegrations should be relied on for verification).
estimate_measurements re-imports json/re inside the function; minor — fine functionally.

Try-on payload size: result_image_b64 (often hundreds of KB) is stored directly in MongoDB and returned in /tryon/history. Will balloon collection size; consider GridFS or signed-URL storage long term.
_compute_fit_summary uses simple L1 distance; acceptable but could weight chest > waist > hips.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral TEST_ users/items via API. Items are cleaned up via DELETE; test users remain (acceptable since prefixed TEST_). Buyer demo account (buyer@aurafit.demo) is registered on first run if missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_aurafit_api.py as the regression suite. Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_aurafit_api.py -v. Public URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The Gemini try-on call is real and costs budget; observed ~30s response. Seller demo creds: atelier@aurafit.demo / demo-seller-2026. Buyer demo creds: buyer@aurafit.demo / demo-buyer-2026. EmailStr rejects .test TLD — use .demo or real domains in payloads.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no backend bugs found. Single initial test failure was test-data only (pydantic EmailStr rejects the reserved-use '.test' TLD); fixed by switching to '@aurafit.demo'.
